1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto perenne, trepador, de hasta 6 m de altura, con flores muy vistosas y frutos de color escarlata; es ornamental. (Solanaceae, Solanum seaforthianum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial climbing shrub, reaching up to 6 m in height, with very showy flowers and scarlet-colored fruits; it is ornamental (Solanaceae, Solanum seaforthianum).
